# MilestoneWins

> Hit a milestone. We celebrate it. MilestoneWins is the board where founders share revenue milestones
> and get a shareable celebration card for each win. Revenue is the headline.

## Key pages

- Launch board: https://milestonewins.com/
- Submit your product: https://milestonewins.com/submit.html
- Weekly archive: https://milestonewins.com/2026/w40/
- Revenue leaderboard: https://milestonewins.com/leaderboard/
- Product Hunt alternative: https://milestonewins.com/alternatives/product-hunt/
- FasLaunch alternative: https://milestonewins.com/alternatives/faslaunch/
- Launch your startup: https://milestonewins.com/launch-your-startup/
- Launch your AI tool: https://milestonewins.com/launch-your-ai-tool/
- Launch your SaaS: https://milestonewins.com/launch-your-saas/
- Privacy: https://milestonewins.com/privacy.html

## Submit

Founders submit at https://milestonewins.com/submit.html — badge-verified launches are free and dofollow,
instant listing is $5 one-time. Sharing revenue is optional; shared revenue is labeled Founder-reported.
